g.text: KayaRank1Convo3 begins.
Time travel - is it expensive? A cost associated in raw materials? Or has it been commodified in your time in a way that is relevant to anything here?
Why? Looking to save up a few höllars and bribe me?
Some costs don’t have höllar signs. And hi, by the way.
It worked on Entrati.
Hi. So it's not like I can just pay someone something and just learn how to do it?
Pardon me?
What?
You know that your batch 'Nova' has nothing to do with Time Travel right?
Listen, you really seem to only care about one thing. Time travel. Why?
You can't. [End].
Check boolean KayaSetFound
What Nova can and can't do doesn't matter.
You wouldn't get it.
+20 Chemistry
Duh, I told you already. I found him.
true
And get this.
false
Check boolean KayaAmirTravel
You don't know me. Or wait, that's your line?
I can promise you I would.
Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank2Convo1.
+5 Chemistry
So he's on his computer or whatever.
Well, we're trying to make the most of our tools I guess. Did you talk to Amir about your questions?
true
Check boolean KayaLettieHeal
false
Yeah, I don't know you. I just know what you can do. Which is why we're talking. Like, be serious.
A promise from a stranger on the internet. Give me a break. Ha. Just tell me what I want to know.
And I show up, and he actually gets scared. Like, he did NOT even expect someone to show up.
I did. We agree on some fundamentals but he doesn't seem interested in a concrete and reproducible time travel theorem.
Well, we're trying to make the most of our tools I guess. Did you talk to Lettie? I feel like you and her would get along.
true
Right, just meant it would be a bit easier I guess if you could access more tools from my time..
false
Ok, let's be serious.
Did something happen to you?
Wow, that's impressive.
Wow are you actually bragging?

In fact, he's convinced me that I was wrong in some of my original hypothesis so it did help, but he reminded me that maybe I can just pay my way to an answer, or at least pay to talk to someone else from the future if you don't help me.
We do get along. She reminds me of a teacher I had once, 0 nastiness and saw me for my brain.
Is that an offer? What can I access? Anything would help.
You want to time travel, but where? Why?
Have you looked around?
Something happened to all of us. Just let me know if you figure out a way to help me out.
Ugh, why am I telling you this again?
For 10 höllars I'll tell you how you die.
Anyone who's selling you something like that is lying. I will try and help you, I really will. No charge.
She's actually really like super chill. Smart too. Although, she told me to trust you for real so, I guess we'll see.
I'll see what I can find for you, if you want to figure it out on your terms.
Can you figure ANYTHING out? Ugh.
Yeah, I have. I've seen it all. This miraculous turn of the millennium. Invites to sooo many parties cause people wanted 'that girl' there.
+20 Chemistry
Just tell me, do I need to save up or anything?
Ugh. Sicko.
We'll see, won't we.
I'm not here to betray you or anything, and I'm not a time travel textbook
I promise you that you can trust me, I'm not sure why you're so hostile.
I do. I will.
Who would even want to stay here? Like..
It's never going to stop. Look forward. Find me when you can help.
Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank2Convo1.
Kaya I think you're a little too hyperfixated on this. What if you can't figure it out?
No idea. I'm the choseeennnn one, Kaya.
+20 Chemistry
+20 Chemistry
Ugh. K
I have my reasons
+20 Chemistry
I'll figure it out, I know I can so, yeah. Bye.
+20 Chemistry
I will.
Yah a total chosen DICKHEAD
